title: [3.3.1.2] Issue with Bluetooth Devices List  "TWI Board"
symptom: After updating to 3.3.1.2 and doing a pod change, there are two 'TWI Board' entries in the Bluetooth device list, both with identical names but different Bluetooth addresses. The user asks about the correct workflow for a pod change and worries about potential problems from having many TWI Board devices.
cause: The thread suggests that the duplicate entries occur because the Omnipod DASH does not present a unique name for the device, and the phone remembers the specific DASH device that was connected. It is not designed to be visible in the list of BT devices.
fix: The thread indicates that AAPS will unbind the pod on de-activation, and the old 'TWI Board' can be removed using unpair/forget device. It also suggests that the phone will probably clean up after some time and that the duplicates can be safely ignored.
evidence_quote: I think that is because DASH does not present a unique name for the device. That was not needed as it was not designed to be visible in the list of BT devices.
